name: Clione Myosotis
original_name: クリオネ・ミオソティス
source:
The young daughter of the wealthy Myosotis family, which regularly helps the temple with donations.

Clione is a talkative young girl who likes listening to rumors and learning new things, though her curiosity can be slightly overbearing at times.
